City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 16, 2020 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Update on Joint Facility Projects by Rania Amen, Engineering Manager at Santa Fe Irrigation District
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 18, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants List.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Authorization to enter a Professional Services Contract with Risk Management Professionals for compliance with America's Water Infrastructure Act, performing a Compliance Crosswalk, Risk and Resilience Assessments, and Emergency Response Plans. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Authorize the City Manager in conjunction with the General Counsel to enter into a contract with Risk Management Professionals in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in the amount of $26,895 plus 20 percent staff level approval contingency for a total not to exceed amount of $32,274; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-11, creating Project No. CW21L and transferring $32,274 from existing Project No. CW21C to new Project No. CW21L, for tracking purposes.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08C AWIA Budget Adjustment
8D.
Proposed revisions the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union - Local 221 amending the vacation accrual limits and vacation cash out provisions. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
Approve Resolution 2020-12 amending the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union - Local 221.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08D Annual Leave Policy
8E.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2019-20 Year-End Budget Report. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Receive and file this report reflecting the San Dieguito Water District’s actual FY 2019-20 available ending net position of $14,372,178.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08E FY19-20 Year-End Budget Report
8F.
Amendment 16 to the Agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the renewal of the existing agreement for a suite of Enterprise software for the City and San Dieguito Water District. Contact Person: IT Applications Supervisor VanPelt
Approve Amendment 16, in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, and authorize the City Manager to enter into the amended agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for a 5-year renewal term for Annual Software Maintenance, and with subsequent 1-year renewal terms for an additional five years, for a total 10-year contract cost of $2,480,852.
2020-12-16 SDWD Item S08F Tyler Technologies Contract Renewal
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 20, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
